description: An allow-list checked with a PARTIAL match. The list is right and the comparison is too generous, which is the harder half to see: a prefix match accepts https://app.example.com.attacker.net and a suffix match accepts https://notexample.com, and the allowed values in both look correct. The negatives are the two right answers -- a set membership test, and a partial match on something that is not an origin, which is how routing is written.

expected.note: a prefix match accepts anything that continues the allowed value
a suffix match accepts anything that precedes it
